newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - April 9.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - April 9.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.
PEOPLE'S DAILY
- Music recital to honour contributions of late Deng Xiaoping held in Beijing
- Liu Huaqing, vice-chairman of Central Military Commission, meets French Defence Minister Charles Millon
- Industrial development normal in first quarter with 11 percent year-on-year increase in industrial output value
XINHUA DAILY TELEGRAPH
- Foreign Ministry spokesman Shen Guofang says China hopes those countries that insist on raising anti-China motion at U.N. human rights commission will decide to stop confrontation.
- Zhang Tong, president of China Great Wall Industry Corporation, dies in accident during visit to France's Guyana Space Centre.
- Vice-Premier Qian Qichen expresses hope Taiwan authorities will no longer prevent entrepreneurs from investing in mainland.
CHINA YOUTH DAILY"
- Project Hope collects 978 million yuan ($117.8 million) in past eight years, allowing 1.5 million children to return to schools.
CHINA SECURITIES
- State Commission for Economic Restructuring outlines reform tasks in financial sector in 1996
- Survey of 13,000 collective firms finds total assets of firms at 139.32 billion yuan, debts at 112.04 billion yuan
- State Planning Commission issues key investment projects for 1997
- Fujian Industrial Bank sets payout ratio on dividen of preferential shares at 14 percent, decides to buy back some preferential shares
FINANCIAL NEWS
- Vice Finance Minister Zhang Youcai outlines target to check assets and capital of urban and rural credit cooperatives
- China Gold Coin Co warns overspeculation could fuel coin price rises
- Huaxia Bank governor Li Xikui warns of risk in interbank and foreign exchange trading, urges tighter controls
- Scandal-hit Suzhou branch of Bank of Communications recalls 620 million yuan in unauthorised loans
MARKET DAILY
- Guangzhou aims to set up big automobile group to produce 150,000 vehicles a year, investment estimated at 7.0-8.0 billion yuan
CHINA BUSINESS TIMES
- China domestic grain prices fall in October-January period, prices of soybeans rise
CHINA CHEMICAL INDUSTRY NEWS
- Ministry of Metallurgical Industry sees China rolled steel exports at 4.0 million tonnes in 1997
CHINA DAILY
- State to appraise assets of urban collective firms
- One-year extension of tax exemption on imports of capital equipment by foreign-invested firms
